purpose: Run an independently frozen human BACE1 receptor-ensemble replication after ESR1 failed its coordinate-pool gate, without using PPARG Stage 19c enrichment results for target selection or tuning.
evidence_timing: Frozen after public DUD-E target counts, BACE1 source-identity inspection, and a label-independent RCSB metadata feasibility screen. No BACE1 coordinate-pool selection, receptor preparation, redocking, production docking, QUBO fit, validation metric, or test metric has been read or run. No PPARG Stage 19c enrichment result was read before this freeze.

esr1.reason: fixed 1SJ0 pocket and anchor compatibility left fewer than 24 coordinate-eligible wild-type structures

prior_target_record.replacement_status: BACE1 is a new preregistered exploratory branch and does not alter or repair the ESR1 failure record.

selection_criteria: ordinary noncovalent small-molecule complexes without a required catalytic metal or covalent scoring mechanism
at least 250 clustered DUD-E actives supporting 75-active fresh-validation and locked-test panels plus a nonempty scaffold-disjoint training panel
at least 24 public wild-type X-ray structures satisfying label-independent metadata criteria

ligand_panel.split_group: Bemis-Murcko scaffold joined with duplicate source IDs before allocation
ligand_panel.rationale_for_train_count: BACE1 has 283 clustered DUD-E actives. Fresh-validation and locked-test retain 75 actives each; all remaining 133 actives form the development-training panel. The smaller training panel is frozen before docking and must be reported when comparing targets.
ligand_panel.failure_action: Stop BACE1 before receptor production docking if all 283 source active molecules cannot be assigned to molecule-, source-, canonical-SMILES-, and scaffold-disjoint panels.

receptor_protocol.coordinate_selection_data: coordinates and metadata only; activity labels and benchmark docking scores prohibited
receptor_protocol.pre_redocking_selection: deterministic max-min active-site geometry from the preparation-ready coordinate pool with the DUD-E reference included
receptor_protocol.post_redocking_final_selection: from passing candidates, deterministically select 16 by max-min active-site geometry; no activity labels or benchmark scores
receptor_protocol.failure_action: If fewer than 24 preparation-ready coordinate candidates exist, or fewer than 16 of the frozen 24 candidates pass the fixed redocking gate, report a BACE1 technical failure without adding structures after reading enrichment results.

production_protocol.score_aggregation: median across seeds per receptor-ligand pair; selected receptor subsets use min_score

analysis_sequence: training panel may be used to fit receptor selectors and baselines
fresh validation is opened once for the frozen trained methods and confirmation gate
locked test remains unopened until the validation decision and all method definitions are frozen
interpretation_boundary: BACE1 can provide prospective exploratory evidence for portability of receptor-ensemble selection and the frozen QUBO formulation on a human protease. It cannot erase earlier target records, establish QUBO superiority by itself, establish experimental binding, or establish quantum advantage.
